streams.why_two_and_not_one: I first proposed ONE code and withdrew it: the two shipped texts are already distinguished BY ACTION ('check your network … now' vs 'on our side … wait'), so collapsing them would lose both clauses. The house rule I cited to justify the collapse names its own CONDITION - indistinguishability AT THE INTERFACE (dist/index.html:14999-15002) - and this pair does not meet it. The error was judging a replacement without measuring what it replaced.
streams.why_the_call_site_and_not_the_transport: `refresh` (`pub(crate) fn refresh` - native_lifecycle.rs:599 PRE / :619 POST) calls the same bootstrap with a STORED credential and has no first step at all, so its identical failure must NOT imply an accepted account. A rename inside native_account.rs would corrupt it. Drill A is exactly this mutation and it is caught.

streams.refactor_oracle_NOT_APPLICABLE_here: Declared inapplicable, not applied. It is built for a PURE refactor (3a), where no counted population moves. 3c changes behaviour, and three asserts carry measured COUNTS inside their NAME (reachable codes=16 mapped=26; 23 keys; functions reached=143), which 3c necessarily changes. The 4+-digit normalisation cannot reach them (two to three digits) and widening it to any digits would collapse No.894/No.898/No.880. And paying debt (i) inside 3c would NOT rescue it: moving a count out of a name IS itself a name change, so LOST would stay 3 with GAINED 3. There is no reachable green for this instrument in this stage - that is the reason, stronger than inconvenience. The instrument is kept as coord/assert-names.mjs (--diff computes the set difference ITSELF: `comm` on two JS-sorted files warns on stderr, prints rows on stdout and returns rc 0, so an exit-code check would accept a non-answer). 3c's oracle instead: the three pinned POST digests, the four drills, and the population numbers above.

not_in_this_grant.why_this_field_exists: A declared write RESERVES scope: overlaps() would count the path occupied and a neighbour needing it would get SEQUENTIAL_REQUIRED for a write that never happens. So a false declaration costs more than an absent one. These were considered and are NOT touched - named here so the reader sees the surface was examined.
